title: The Original plan of the building
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：original　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 original 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the tailor wrote of ① an original plan of the building in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so original that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the original ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the original plan of the building that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too original to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the original ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an original idea of the pupil, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as original as the idea of the pupil they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was original or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something original, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite original; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the original ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, in silence, she wrote of another original plan of the building in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less original than anybody had expected. ⑩ The original idea of the pupil that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the original ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 最初（前置定语 an original plan of the building：1989 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件最初的设计）
B. adj. 最初／原创（两处加强说法：so original that … 与 no less original than …）
C. adj. 最初／原创（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 最初（表语 too original to do：母亲觉得它太最初，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 原创（前置定语 an original idea of the pupil：叔叔把整件事称作一桩原创的想法）
F. adj. 原创（同级比较 as original as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学生原创的想法相比）
G. adj. 原创（后置定语 something original：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 原创（受程度副词修饰 quite original：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an original plan of the building
the original plan of the building that
an original idea of the pupil
The original idea of the pupil that

answers.why: original 意为“最初”，1989 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件最初的设计”，此处作前置定语 an original plan of the building。
original 意为“最初”，此处用 so original that 结构，说它最初到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
original 意为“最初”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的最初建筑最初的设计，等于最高级的说法。
original 意为“最初”，母亲认为这件东西“太最初了，谁也用不上”，too original to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
original 意为“原创”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩原创的想法”，此处作前置定语 an original idea of the pupil。
original 意为“原创”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学生原创的想法一样原创”，同级比较用 as original as。
original 意为“原创”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“原创的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something original。
original 意为“原创”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当原创”，quite 修饰原级 original。
original 意为“原创”，no less original than 表示“其原创不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之原创不亚于任何人的预料。
original 意为“原创”，母亲 2001 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的原创想法”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件最初的设计。（an original plan of the building）
它最初到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so original that …）
母亲觉得它太最初，谁也用不上。（too original to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩原创的想法。（an original idea of the pupil）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学生原创的想法一样原创。（as original as …）
到了 1996 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件原创的东西。（something original）
answers: In 1989 the tailor wrote of an original plan of the building in the order.
It was so original that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too original to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an original idea of the pupil.
He said nobody would call it as original as the idea of the pupil they had once had.
By 1996 the order asked for nothing but something original.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 original 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the tailor wrote of an original plan of the building in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the original plan of the building that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too original to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an original idea of the pupil, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite original, and everybody laughed.
The original ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
